title.zh: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
title.en: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out

current_state.zh: Bitcoin slid about 5% to roughly $76,500, erasing its post-election rally and dragging Ethereum and most major tokens lower, as a Wall Street tech selloff over AI spending triggered ~$428 million in crypto long liquidations within an hour.
